cohorts: Official held-out splits; FF++ c23 first, then c0 and c40 where available. Evaluate each codec independently.
sampling: Use up to 16 equally spaced successful decoded frame indices over each video. Attempt crop extraction only at those indices; log every failure.
preprocessing: Supply RGB128 PNG face crops from one externally pinned detector/tracker and one fixed ROI/resize policy. Record executable version, weights digest, ROI geometry, resize settings and sampling audit before label release. No restoration, alignment-by-class, per-dataset tuning or label-driven rejection.
primary_endpoint: Video-level AUROC on FaceForensics++ c23 and Celeb-DF v2 separately.
secondary_endpoints: Frame and video average precision, fixed-threshold balanced accuracy, confusion matrix, per-manipulation and codec metrics, and paired model comparisons.
exploratory: Report reversed ranking separately. Use ensemble disagreement for description only.
cluster: Dependence blocks declared before join. Use shared source lineage where known; record unresolved cross-block donor/identity overlap.
labels: Separate custodian or process keeps labels inaccessible until final source-only freeze and label-blind target scores are sealed.
